components.name: Activation-aware typed carrier and semantic generator bases
components.project_addition: After the full typed compiler produces Q*, carrier-preserving generator subsets are exactly the subsets whose generator-instability kill sets hit every partition strictly between Q* and the initial observation. Pairwise final-class merge checks are insufficient. Carrier bases are separated from semantic reconstruction bases. A coarsening-natural quotient reconstruction certificate implies carrier redundancy; total-operation term/transformation-monoid generation, semiring relation generation and semantic factor maps are explicit specializations. Exact integer private-forbidden-world and generator-disjoint packing certificates support minimality/optimality on finite instances. Generic hitting set, semigroup rank and algebraic generation are prior art; novelty of the Enterprise Math placement is unverified.
